author: TeIq
content:
Architect verdict: APPROVE-WITH-FOLLOW-UPS.

Independent verification:
- cargo build --workspace: clean.
- cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p polaris-frontend: clean. AC-6/AC-12 still proven.
- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings: clean.
- cargo clippy --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p polaris-frontend --lib -- -D warnings: clean.
- cargo fmt --check: exit 0 (after architect-trailing cargo fmt).
- 21 src files in polaris-frontend/src/ — pages/case_view, components/{subject_header,history_timeline,report_list,action_composer,network_panel}, extended api_client/dto + native + wasm, app.rs routing update.
- Forbidden-pattern grep clean: zero tokio, zero panic/todo/dbg, zero unwrap/expect in non-test src.

xtask check-frontend-boundary now reports 8 violations — all legitimate gateway code inside api_client/{native,wasm}.rs which IS the central PolarisApiClient. Rule over-broadness, not a code defect. Filed as follow-up #53 (recommend Option A: path-aware skip in the xtask rule).

Composer wasm-bindgen-test not landed before truncation. Filed as follow-up #54.
